_about: Israeli trade slang and everyday Hebrew product names that AI models and AliExpress don't read well. Hebrew word -> what it is, in sellers' English. Only a matching entry is added to the understanding request (no cost otherwise). Owner reviews every entry (2026-11-03).
מוט פינוק: rain shower system (shower column with an overhead rain head and a hand shower)
אינטרפוץ: concealed shower mixer valve (in-wall shower diverter)
אינטרפול: a typo of אינטרפוץ: concealed shower mixer valve
דיסק: angle grinder (when it is a tool) or cutting disc
סקוטש: velcro / hook and loop tape (not scotch tape)
שלט: remote control (when it is a device)
ג'ק: car jack (when it is about a car)
פלטת שבת: Shabbat hot plate / food warming tray
פלטה: food warming plate (Shabbat hot plate) when it is about food
ספונג'ה: floor squeegee and mop cloth (Israeli floor washing)
לדים: LED strip lights (Israeli usage: 'לדים לחדר' = decorative LED light strips for a room, not ceiling lamps or fans)
מגהץ: a clothes iron; sellers title it "steam iron" or "garment steamer" ("iron" alone found 1 iron among 50, free check 2026-11-05)
תבנית אפייה: a cake or baking mold; sellers title it "cake mold" or "silicone baking mold" ("baking pan" found 8 strong vs 29)
קישוטים ליום הולדת: birthday party decorations; sellers title them "happy birthday banner" or "birthday party decorations set" ("birthday decorations" found mostly cartoon partyware)
שטיח: a home floor rug when nothing else is named; sellers title it "bedroom rug" or "living room rug" ("carpet" alone found car floor mats)
מדף: a shelf; sellers title it "wall shelf" or "floating shelf" ("shelf" alone found 6 strong vs 16)
קולבים: clothes hangers; sellers title them "non slip hangers" or "velvet hangers" ("hanger" alone found none)
קולב: a clothes hanger; sellers title them "non slip hangers" or "velvet hangers" ("hanger" alone found none)
צמיד כושר: a fitness tracker band; sellers title it "activity tracker" ("smart band" found mostly watch straps)
שטיח לאמבטיה: a bathroom rug; sellers title it "bathroom rug" or "non slip bath mat" ("bath mat" found 11 strong vs 30)
